notes.title: update notes for April 1
notes.content:
this ain't no April fools, folks!

first of all, huge thanks to [b]peon2[/b] for finding a bug in Harmful Ham Valley that was preventing the indicator for all-star from showing up correctly. that's been fixed.

peon2 is also our world record holder in the any% category, and that status will now be displayed IN-GAME!

lastly, there is now a 5-second delay before the player can exit the game win screen. This should allow for plenty of time to upload the run time to the steam leaderboards.

thanks again to all the racers out there!
